summary: This workshop is designed to teach traditional Himalayan methods of working with Tibetan bowls.
intro: Sound vibration therapy with Tibetan singing bowls is a unique method of relieving mental stress and restoring a person’s nervous system and energy structure. Connecting with nature through this ancient technique can help heal ourselves and bring our attention toward our well-being.

Sound healing is a therapeutic process that uses various sounds and vibrations to promote healing and wellness. It is said that everything in this universe has its sound and vibration. When the energy levels in the body become imbalanced, it has a detrimental impact on our physical and mental health. Thus, the Tibetan sound healing technique balances this energy in the body.

This course is ideal for people who want to understand healing techniques through Tibetan singing bowls and want to teach others as a teacher. People who wish to unlock its benefits for their well-being can join this course. This workshop is designed to teach traditional Himalayan methods of working with Tibetan bowls. Moreover, you will also learn how to use this healing method in your day-to-day life and can also share this knowledge with your loved ones.

issues: No course length is stated anywhere on the page (no 'Length of the Course' line, unlike Level 2–5 pages). The daily schedule shows Day 1 (check-in 12:00 pm) and Day 2 (check-out 12:00 pm), implying 2 days / 1 night, but this is not stated — duration set to null. CSV helper elsewhere lists Level 1 Reiki as '2 days & 1 Night', not this page.
Course hours are not stated (hours = null).
Inclusions list 'Private accommodation with 24h hot water availability' for all options, including Twin Shared and Only Course (no accommodation).
Booking text is self-contradictory: 'deposit the Complete course fees of 100 USD' and refers to 'yoga retreat fees' on a sound healing page.
Certifying body differs from the combined Level 1/2/3 page (this page: only 'Himalayan Yoga Association Yoga Society'; combined page adds International Yoga Organisation).
Only Course original price (350 USD) equals the Twin Shared offer price (350 USD) — coincidental but worth confirming.

Page contains 'Benefits Of Tibetan Singing Bowl Meditation/Massage' list with unverified health claims (e.g. alleviates symptoms of mild depression, detoxifies the body, improves neurological health) and the claim 'massaging your body with this method can help stimulate trillions of cells' and 'other musical instruments are less powerful than the Tibetan singing bowl technique' — not extracted; unverified.
Meta description says 'basic sound healing techniques'; page body describes the course as also for those who want to teach as a teacher to others — ensure positioning is not overstated.
